AD QUÆST. III.
Omnis quantitas est finita & proprio fine seu termino,
& alieno (loci) excepta quantitate vltimi seu extremi cor-
poris. Hoc enim alieno externoque fine actu termina-
tum uon est.
AD QUÆST. X.
Aristoteli tempus vnum numeroeft[?] & continuum seu
quantitas continua; quia eius partes copulantur in in-
stanti medio tanquam in communi termino. Vide Zaba-
rellam in 8 Phys pag. 115.
AD QUÆST. XIV.
Communem sententiam Philosophorum sequitur
Scaliger[?], vnitatem numerum esse negans, quod ei nu-
meri essentia sit, esse non vnum: Exerc. 65. (sect. 2.)

page.notes: Doubtful readings marked [?]: "conereto" (probably concreto), "vrlati", "numeroeft" (printed without a space), "Scaliger" (the scan reads "Scal'ger"), "respectu" (scan reads "refpecu"), "mensu-ratarum" (line-end split uncertain), "quatuor" (word unclear), "rebus" (scan reads "ebus"). Printing error kept as printed: "uon" for non. Printed "fineactu" was transcribed as "fine actu". The footnote mark "3" after "intellectu." has no matching note on this page; the footer text is not printed. The bottom margin shows only a digitiser's watermark, which was left out.
